product_launches.description: Lightrun launched the Runtime Aware PR Verifier, a tool that analyzes live runtime data from code paths touched by a pull request to simulate its impact on production, assign a risk score, and surface issues directly within GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket.

press_references.value: Lightrun ‘Runtime Context’ Empowers AI Coding Agents to Build Software That Works in the Real World

product_launches.description: Lightrun introduced a new Model Context Protocol-based Runtime Context solution that gives AI coding agents secure access to runtime code behavior across environments to improve autonomous software reliability.

overview_description.description: Lightrun offers tools that enable developers to gain insights from live applications without interrupting their operations. The platform supports dynamic instrumentation, allowing users to add logs, metrics, and traces directly from their Integrated Development Environment (IDE). This capability simplifies the monitoring process in production environments, making it easier for teams to troubleshoot issues as they arise. Additionally, Lightrun features a GenAI model designed for runtime debugging, which automates the identification and resolution of problems in real-time. This approach enhances developer efficiency and streamlines the debugging process, providing valuable support for software development teams.

about_short_description.short_description: Lightrun provides real-time application insights and dynamic instrumentation for developers.

product.name: Lightrun AI SRE Platform
product.description: A production-reliability platform that provides live runtime context for investigating incidents, analyzing root causes, validating fixes, and improving software reliability.

product.name: Lightrun Runtime Sensor
product.description: A read-only runtime instrumentation product that connects developers and AI agents to live application execution data for code validation, performance analysis, and production debugging without redeployment.

product.name: Lightrun Runtime Aware PR Verifier
product.description: A pull-request verification product that simulates how code changes affect live system behavior and checks whether a proposed change satisfies its linked requirements before merge.

product.name: Lightrun Dynamic Observability
product.description: A developer-focused observability capability for adding runtime logs, metrics, traces, and snapshots to running applications on demand, reducing the need for code changes or redeployments.
